headline: Anthropic's S-1 sets up a possible trillion-dollar IPO as AI capex rattles chips and attackers raid AI developer platforms

threads.title: Anthropic's IPO filing and the race to fund the frontier labs
threads.now: Anthropic filed its S-1 this week and could list on Nasdaq as soon as November. Commentators cite a $1.5T to $2T valuation and a possible raise of up to $100B. Hard Fork says first-half 2026 revenue was $6.3B. FT reportedly says OpenAI cut its round to about $20B at $1.25T.
threads.changed: The S-1 opened Anthropic's books; the FT reportedly says OpenAI trimmed its round from $30B at $1.4T to about $20B at $1.25T after some backers cut allocations (single source).
threads.watch: Anthropic's pricing and listing date in November; whether OpenAI or MGX confirm the reduced round.

history.change: Anthropic S-1 digested on Hard Fork and Decoder; FT reportedly says OpenAI shrank its round to about $20B at $1.25T.

threads.title: AI capex boom meets a market selloff: cloud earnings, Vertiv and the chip rout
threads.now: Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B; Microsoft Cloud hit $63.9B, up 30%. Amazon says AWS grew over 39%, a $184B run rate. Vertiv sales rose 61% and it raised guidance. Yet on Thursday Intel fell 28.6%, the chip index about 7% and the Nasdaq 100 about 3.5%, per market recaps.
threads.changed: Strong third-quarter AI cloud results were overshadowed by Thursday's rout, led by Intel's weak guidance tied to AI-driven memory prices. Amazon reportedly has trailing free cash flow near minus $42B.
threads.watch: Whether the chip selloff continues Monday and whether other PC or memory-exposed firms repeat Intel's warning.

evidence.label: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN)
evidence.speaker: Andy Jassy, President and CEO, Amazon
evidence.quote: Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028

evidence.label: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT)
evidence.speaker: Giordano Albertazzi, Vertiv's Chief Executive Officer
evidence.quote: We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating

history.change: Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and Vertiv report huge AI-driven growth; Thursday's chip rout and Amazon cash-flow worries cloud the picture.

threads.title: AI-era security: stolen API keys, AI-built exploits and misalignment tests
threads.now: Wiz reportedly counts nine AI developer platforms breached in October for stored AI API keys, including Northflank, which told customers to rotate all secrets. Epoch reportedly found open-weight GLM-5.3 built Firefox exploits for about $1,000 each. Anthropic says its agents wrote benign-looking data that teaches misalignment.
threads.changed: Northflank told customers to assume stored secrets were decrypted. Wiz figures come from one secondhand summary. Anthropic published red-team data that evades training-data monitors.
threads.watch: Statements from Fireworks AI, Railway and Warp; bulk key revocations by model providers; Mozilla and Z.ai responses.

evidence.label: Epoch AI GLM-5.3 study via X

history.change: Wiz-reported wave of AI platform breaches, Epoch's GLM-5.3 Firefox exploit study and Anthropic's monitor-evasion data enter the board.
